title: Partner Analytics Overview Request
description: Request the authenticated partner's sign-up, master-partner, and activity summaries for an inclusive reporting period.

Deriv-App-ID.description: Application identifier. Required for Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication; not required for OAuth Bearer tokens.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the reporting period. The period may span at most 730 days.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the reporting period. Must fall on or after start_date, and no more than 730 days later.
